facts.fact: The report says Algeria's SNTN-2030 (National Digital Transformation Strategy) was launched in 2025, naming no adopting act.
The report's table names the High Commissioner for Digitization and the Ministry of Post, Telecom and Digital Technology as lead institutions of SNTN-2030 for 2025-2030.

The report says publicly available, disaggregated ICT budget data for Algeria are limited; the only identifiable 2024 allocation, about USD 730,000 (97.5 million DZD), is not tied to the strategy and is called partial.
The report gives SNTN-2030 a stated period of 2025-2030; it does not say whether the text is public (published date 2026-09-22 used).
